documents.title: A lithium superionic conductor
documents.abstract: Reports the lithium superionic conductor Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) with a room-temperature ionic conductivity of about 1.2e-2 S/cm, comparable to liquid electrolytes, enabling all-solid-state lithium batteries. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: High-power all-solid-state batteries using sulfide superionic conductors
documents.abstract: Demonstrates high-power all-solid-state batteries using the sulfide superionic conductor Li9.54Si1.74P1.44S11.7Cl0.3 with a room-temperature conductivity of about 2.5e-2 S/cm. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Fast Lithium Ion Conduction in Garnet-Type Li7La3Zr2O12
documents.abstract: Reports cubic garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 (LLZO) with a room-temperature bulk ionic conductivity around 3e-4 S/cm and good chemical stability against lithium metal. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Electrical properties of amorphous lithium electrolyte thin films
documents.abstract: Characterizes amorphous LiPON thin-film solid electrolytes with room-temperature ionic conductivity near 2e-6 S/cm and excellent stability in contact with lithium. as-reported for engineering demo.

documents.title: Li6PS5X: A Class of Crystalline Li-Rich Solids With an Unusually High Li+ Mobility
documents.abstract: Introduces the Li6PS5X argyrodite family with unusually high lithium-ion mobility; Li6PS5Cl shows room-temperature conductivity in the mS/cm to 1e-3 S/cm range depending on preparation. as-reported for engineering demo.
